children.value: > Fact From Story: Hamas' surprise attack on Israel has shocked many who are now questioning the country's famed intelligence agency Mossad, which is known for its intelligence-gathering capability.

> > Fact From Story: For some, the belief that Mossad was among the best in the spying world was shattered today when Hamas carried out the biggest coordinated attack in Israel and captured some territory in southern Israel.
> > > Fact From Story: The strategic planning that must have gone into this against "one of the most high-tech occupation and surveillance systems in the world" will be studied by many.
> > > Fact From Story: It is not the attack that has surprised people but the scale at which Hamas operated and got control of some military bases and soldiers.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A large-scale, well-planned attack indicates a significant intelligence failure if it was not foreseen.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A surprise attack that succeeds suggests a failure of intelligence.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Intelligence agencies are expected to prevent surprise attacks.
